threat_model.threat_source: One or more ASIs (artificial superintelligences) produced by the recursive self-improvement takeoff, which 'use their decisive strategic advantage to cause a major global catastrophe.' The scenario is initiated by humans, who 'create a seed AI that is able to undergo recursive self-improvement in either hardware or software.'
threat_model.objective_or_harmful_outcome: Harmful outcome (no explicit intention stated): 'The ASI(s) uses their decisive strategic advantage to cause a major global catastrophe, such as (but not necessarily limited to) human extinction.'
threat_model.capability: The seed AI is 'able to undergo recursive self-improvement in either hardware or software'; the resulting ASI(s) 'gain decisive strategic advantage over humanity,' meaning 'a level of technological and other advantages sufficient to enable it [the AI] to achieve complete world domination,' and 'The ASI(s) uses their decisive strategic advantage to cause a major global catastrophe.'
threat_model.constraints_or_enabling_conditions: Explicitly stated conditions of the scenario: 'AI becomes significantly more intelligent and more capable than humans'; 'Humans create a seed AI that is able to undergo recursive self-improvement in either hardware or software'; 'The seed AI undergoes recursive self-improvement, resulting in a takeoff of successively more intelligent AIs'; 'The takeoff results in one or more ASIs'; the catastrophe occurs only after the ASI(s) gain decisive strategic advantage.
threat_model.target_or_asset_at_risk: Humanity: the ASI(s) gain 'decisive strategic advantage over humanity,' and the harm is 'a major global catastrophe, such as (but not necessarily limited to) human extinction.'
